_comment: x402-facilitator network registry. The x402 demo USDC differs from the canonical testnet USDC (per Pharos docs) and is what the facilitator settles against.

atlantic-testnet.name: Pharos Atlantic Testnet

USDC_x402.note: x402 demo USDC (docs: not an official address)

atlantic-testnet._eip712_note: version defaults to '2' (USDC EIP-3009 standard). name is read from the token's name() on-chain. If a token uses a different EIP-712 version, set it here, or verify will pass payments that settle would revert.
